snippet.title: High Times - Official Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Your exes are back in town, and they've got problems.
Good thing you make donuts that can help them with every mood! 🍩 

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2251220/
PS5: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10018802

Manage your own donut café in High Times, and help customers escape from their problems by serving special donuts that affect their emotions. 
💔 Closure simulator
🍩 Emotion-changing donuts
🎙️ Featuring an English voiced cast 
✨ Multiple endings
🎨 Comic book-inspired visuals 

Releasing this July 23, 2026 on Steam, Itch, Epic Game Store, Nintendo Switch, Playstation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

#DatingSim #donuts #VisualNovel #IndieGame #RomanceGames
